summary: No scan concurrency guard, cancellation or timeout; duplicate scans run in parallel and a hung clamscan is never stopped
evidence: commands.rs:45-48 AppState has no in-progress flag; commands.rs:65-77 spawn per invoke; clamav.rs:68-88 Command::output() with no timeout or kill; lib.rs:17-23 no cancel command. Confirms the backend half of FND-0018.
failure_scenario: scan_start("C:\\") invoked twice (e.g. after section switch) runs two full-disk clamscan processes. On app exit the child may be orphaned (UNVERIFIED: job object).
resolution_note: Re-verifier CONFIRM-PARTIAL: single-scan guard, cancel, timeout and limits verified by trace and tests on Linux. Windows-only items UNVERIFIED: clamscan --max-scantime/--max-filesize behaviour, Child::kill on clamscan.exe, orphaned clamscan if the app exits mid-scan (no job object), possible spin if kill() fails. Windows check required.
